**Exploring popcorn clues**

I’m thinking about clues related to popcorn. It’s intriguing how it can pop and get so big! There’s the element of fire and wind, especially with air-popped popcorn. I wonder if “puffed rice” could be a clue too since it relates to similar popping ideas. I might even make three guesses about these clues and see where it leads me. It’s fun to play around with these concepts!
